content.comment_body: I've used the text display block, but nothing appears on the display. The only way I can see anything is by using the line ticker function. Any suggestions? I'm working with a [product_name] 24 VDC, [article_no].
Hi, could you share your program so I can review it? Also, what firmware version is shown on the text display module when you power it on?

Thanks for your response. The issue is resolved now, but maybe this information will help others. There was no clear guidance on where to place the message for the display. In the message editor, there's a large screen with green and blue sections. I was using the blue area, which turns out to be intended for overflow or ticker text. That's why my messages only appeared with the ticker functions. After looking through multiple examples, I found one that used a text message correctly and realized the green area should be used for static display.
Hello [user_name], have you seen this FAQ: How can message texts be displayed with [product_name] as of device series [article_no]? Hope this helps. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user had difficulty presenting messages on a [product_name] device's text module, only seeing output when using ticker functions. The confusion stemmed from unclear instructions regarding placement within the message editor, specifically not distinguishing between the green area (for static messages) and the blue overflow/ticker area. Reviewing example projects helped the user understand that static messages should be placed in the green section.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking clear instructions for using the text display module and an easy way to input messages for proper static display.
